programme.title: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Charlotte’s taking her chance in the big city. She just began working for the hottest romance site writing their hit weekly dating article, and her new best friend, Lila, is as fun as she is loyal. She also befriends a coffee barista, Liam, who shows her all the best spots in the city. But dating a new guy each week to write about is making her feel burned out. And when Liam develops feelings for her, Charlotte will need to decide whether her work is more important than her chance at love.

programme.title: My Perfect Romance
programme.desc: Robinson Tech is launching a new dating service that they ensure will find your Perfect Match. But when its's CEO and tech developer are challenged on Live TV to test the service themselves, the algorithm shows some interesting results.

programme.title: SnowBound For Christmas
programme.desc: Eager to impress Adrian, her boss, Rachel lands a spot on a big project. Before the presentation, a snowstorm traps her and Adrian at a resort where they realize there is more to their relationship than just business

programme.title: Dishing Up Love
programme.desc: A brilliant but lonely gourmet chef and a rugged diner cook go head-to-head in a big contest. It's a main course of sumptuous food with a side of spicy competition, and delectable antics for dessert. If only they can discover the ultimate recipe... the recipe for love.

programme.title: Love In Aruba
programme.desc: A lonely teacher (Amber) is hired by Connor, the single father of a struggling student. She is to tutor his daughter Macey (age 10) over a summer while they travel for his work. As Amber helps Macey, she sees glimpses of what’s missing in the family’s life. Their grand destinations are filled with rich items and potential rewarding business deals, but it’s missing heart. Amber’s influence fills the void and brings Macey and Connor together. With it, Amber starts to fall in love with Connor, but can he see her as anything beyond the hired help?

programme.title: Love in Focus
programme.desc: When the hit show actress Jenna Wilde stars in suddenly gets cancelled, the press start circling. To escape the chaos Jenna retreats to a snowy cabin in the mountains. Unexpectedly, she must share this peaceful place with a rude and rugged nature photographer Chris Dixon. Their coolness towards each other starts to thaw when Chris helps Jenna audition for other shows.

programme.title: Moving McAllister
programme.desc: Rick Robinson is a ladder-climbing law intern from Miami with four days until the Bar Exam. Desperate to score points with his boss (McAllister), he commits to a favor he can't afford. He ends up in a rundown truck headed to L.A. with his boss's possessions, his Hollywood-bound niece, and her pet pig. Amidst hitch-hikers, breakdowns, and assorted local yokels, Rick finds love, life and maybe himself in this trans-American road trip from hell.
